correctness.rationale: Orbit barycenters give the exact geometric fixed realization; distance rules force the exhaustive three-type S/T/U facet list for every integer q>=3. Deleting each B-orbit from Y has link a contractible three-simplex-cover path (overlaps through persistent A_{a,c} and A_{b,c}); Y is homotopy equivalent to the rook clique complex and hence to K_{q,q}. The remaining N=q²(q−1)²/2 triangles attach along all rook rectangles, including a free-group generating family, so π1 vanishes. The relative cellular exact sequence gives H2≅Z^{N−(q−1)²} and H1=0; 2-dimensional homotopy type plus Hurewicz/Whitehead gives the claimed S² wedge. The actual standalone verifier matched all maximal facets for q=2..5 and computed mod-two homology for q=2..4. Finite tests do not replace all-q proof.

value.rationale: The first-two-coordinate involution is a canonical symmetry of q-ary three-coordinate Hamming Rips complexes. Complete geometric fixed-point homotopy types are structural invariants that ambient (nonequivariant) Betti numbers and rational symmetry characters cannot determine. The theorem gives a uniform natural classification across every nonbinary alphabet and explains the two-dimensional classes geometrically by triangle relations in a rook-graph nerve. It also contrasts with the already available multinary 3-cycle fixed loci, which have one-dimensional homology; this is not merely a numerical recomputation or an arbitrary finite slice.
